headline: The Single Biggest Reason to Buy Exxon Mobil Before July 31st
summary: Exxon Mobil heads into its July 31 earnings report carrying a streak most energy companies can only dream about, and Wall Street is pricing in a very high chance it gets even better before summer ends.
